title: Oven-Grilled Jumbo Shrimp with Celery and Dill
author: Iman Adel Abdel-Fattah (Daily News Egypt)
desc: Jumbo shrimp baked under foil on a bed of tomato, onion, lemon, celery and dill with garlic and cumin, then uncovered for ten more minutes.
longDesc: Shelled jumbo shrimp are laid on sliced onion, lemon and tomato with celery, dill, garlic, lemon juice and cumin, covered and baked at 200C for 10 to 15 minutes, then uncovered for another 10 minutes.
ingredients: 1/2 kg jumbo shrimp, shelled – gam-ba-ri jum-bo
salt and pepper – malh and fel-fel
steps: Layer the onion, lemon and tomato slices with the celery and dill in a baking dish, lay the shrimp on top and season with garlic, lemon juice, cumin, salt and pepper.
Cover and bake 10 to 15 minutes, then uncover and bake another 10 minutes.
chefTips: The page gives no shrimp doneness cue; judge by the shrimp turning opaque and pink (our note). The method has a typo, 'sprinkle the garlic with the garlic'.
commonMistakes: Baking uncovered from the start, which dries the shrimp.
sources: Adapted from 'Bites Fil Beit Ramadan: Gambari meshwi au mahamar we kaboria meshweya', Daily News Egypt. BYLINE AS PRINTED: 'Iman Adel Abdel-Fattah'. Date as printed: August 1, 2013. Yield not stated; servings are our estimate.
